table.name: TLGNT_TABLE_META
table.description: Meta data about tables, controls how the Generic Table Browser allows access to manipulate data in the LOGON data-base. A table which is not listed here is not editable at all in the table browser.

column.name: TABLE_NAME
column.description: Name of the data-base table as known by Oracle, i.e. all upper case.

column.name: INSERT_ALLOWED
column.description: 1=inserting into table table_name via table browser is allowed.

column.name: UPDATE_ALLOWED
column.description: 1=updating an existing record in table table_name via table browser is allowed. tlgnt_column_meta may restrict further and forbid updating certain columns.

column.name: DELETE_ALLOWED
column.description: 1=deleting a record in table table_name via table browser is allowed.

column.name: REFERENCED_FIELD
column.description: If the table is referenced from another table (example: tlgnc_carrier.sap_vendor_id -> tlgns_sap_vendor), the PK of that table is displayed. If referenced_field is set some other (more user-readable) attribute, e.g. sap_id could be specified instead.

column.name: USE_DROPDOWN
column.description: 1=If this table is referenced from another table, a dropdown is be used to select a value (add/edit). 0=Popup.
